testcase.system-out: Scenario: Find drawing entries inside a collapsed resource branch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a border resource and a sheet border ✔ And the drawing resources branch is collapsed in the browser ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser search field ✔ And the user enters "Border" ✔ Then the filtered tree shows the matching border resource under its parent branches ✔ And the filtered tree shows the matching sheet border ✔ And the matching text is highlighted ✔ When the user clears the search text ✔ Then the unfiltered tree is restored ✔ And the drawing resources branch is collapsed ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible
